instruction.task: Implement Phase 1, Slice 6 closeout for the Agency Command Center ERP.
instruction.objective: Complete Phase 1 quality, security, documentation, and acceptance coverage without adding future-scope features.

section.title: 1. Phase 1 Acceptance Testing
section.requirement: Add focused tests for bearer parsing, role guards, inactive users, missing ERP users, and forbidden access.
Verify client onboarding rolls back if workflow or task generation fails.
Verify allowed transitions, blocked-task completion rejection, completion percentage recalculation, and activity logs.
Verify blocker creation blocks tasks and resolution restores only when no open blockers remain.
Verify health status, open blocker count, overdue tasks, and tenant-filtered aggregation.

section.title: 2. Security and Tenant Hardening
section.requirement: Audit all repository queries for tenant_id filters and relationship ownership checks.
Verify no endpoint accepts tenant_id, user_id, created_by, completed_by, resolved_by, or status side effects from untrusted bodies.
Ensure raw Prisma/Supabase/database errors are not exposed to frontend users.

section.title: 3. Documentation and Runbook
section.requirement: Keep docs/current/features.md aligned with all Phase 1 slices and implemented modules.
Document env variables, Supabase SQL setup, tenant/user bootstrap, template seeding, and dev server startup.
Ensure Swagger documents implemented endpoints only.

logic.description: Do not implement notifications, realtime, CRM sync, billing, AI, dependency engine, Kanban, Gantt, or mobile features.
Phase 1 closeout must verify the full path from login to client onboarding to workflow/task execution to blocker resolution to dashboard derivation.

item.req: Focused backend and frontend tests for Phase 1 behavior
Feature map, setup runbook, Swagger review

instruction.first_principles_check: Phase 1 is complete only when the system can be trusted as a tenant-safe operational record for onboarding, workflows, tasks, blockers, and dashboard visibility.
